items.title: Can Hezbollah’s shadow financial network survive fresh US sanctions?
items.source_excerpt: Since October 2023, Israel has intensified its campaign against Hezbollah's financial network, targeting entities like Al-Qard Al-Hassan, which allegedly functions as the group's bank. In response, the U.S. has sanctioned individuals and businesses linked to Hezbollah's funding, unveiling a network that utilizes gold trading and cash transfers from Africa to circumvent traditional banking systems. Despite these pressures, experts suggest that Hezbollah's multi-dimensional financial structure remains resilient, enabling it to continue operations and support its activities.
